items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: We had a concert, Reese and I. We had Ella and Cootie Williams' band.

ctx.x: But Reese Dupree owned the Strand Ballroom. We had a concert, Reese and I. We had Ella and Cootie Williams' band. And after the concert, Reese had a bunch of guys with him.

They took all the money and put it in a bag and Reese sat down and put that bag on his chair, and these guys were standing around him. So I said, "Well Reese, let's check up." He said, "Price, I just can't help it." I said, "Can't help what?" He start telling me what he owe and how many; I said, "Okay."
